title: Industries Overview
meta_description: Twelve industries with sub-industry depth — each page maps the sector's programs, regulatory posture and the capability towers aligned to it.

blocks.x: Twelve industries, each with sub-industry depth and capability pages that align the towers to the sector's operating physics. Industry pages here are not brochures: they carry the pressures, the regulatory regimes and the programs that actually move numbers.

The structure is deliberate. Industry hubs give the operating picture. Sub-industry pages go down to the operating unit — payments, health insurance, 3PL freight. Capability pages align each tower to the sector with named workflows and regimes.
Select your industry below — or come to a briefing with your metric, and we will map it to the right sub-industry and tower in 45 minutes.
Talk to the team that runs the section map above in production — the briefing is technical by design, and the first one costs nothing but the hour.
